summary: Titan Mining Corp filed a Form 6-K furnishing a Report of Voting Results from its Annual General Meeting held June 25, 2026. 69,858,802 shares (71.08%) were represented. Shareholders approved setting the board at seven directors, elected directors including Richard Warke (90.40% for) and others, and appointed Ernst & Young as auditor (99.82% for). This is a routine disclosure of ordinary-course meeting outcomes, not a special situation event.
